note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 1 June 1933 in Glenshesk only. Nominations closed on Wednesday 10 May 1933 (Ballymoney Free Press, 11 May 1933, p. 2). No nomination was received for Croagh and Ramoan; the retiring members, James Matthews and W. G. B. Hayes, J.P., 'both Unionists', were returned (Ballymoney Free Press, 11 May 1933, p. 2), named in that order. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
